description: Check a source file or diff for AI 'tells' left in comments: narrating fulfilling a request instead of describing the code ("as requested," "I've added," "here's the updated version") and hedge words. These reveal there was a conversation behind the change that a later reader has no access to. Call this before committing or shipping code an agent wrote.

code.description: The source file or diff to check

name: check_code
title: Check code comments
